heading: About Honorbrook Insurance
name: About Honorbrook Insurance
description: Who Honorbrook Insurance is, what independent means, the coverage we help with, where we are licensed and the languages we speak. Then how scheduling works in 4 steps.
transcript: About Honorbrook Insurance. Who we are, what we help with, and how we work with you. Honorbrook Insurance is an independent, licensed agency in Virginia. Our office is in Tysons. Your licensed agent is Luay Sadqi. Independent means we represent you, not one carrier. One agent compares 90+ carriers, and explains your options in plain English. We help with Medicare, health, life and retirement, for individuals, families and employers. We are licensed in 16 states and Washington, DC. Plans and rules differ by state and county, so we start with your ZIP code. We help in English, Arabic, French and Spanish. Scheduling takes 4 steps. Select Schedule an appointment. Create your profile. Add your doctors, prescriptions and current coverage. Then ask for your meeting. We read everything before we talk. Office visits are by appointment in Tysons, Virginia. Everywhere else, we work by phone or video. Carriers pay us, and your premium is the same either way. Choosing a plan is your decision. Want to talk it through? Schedule a time at honorbrook-insurance.com or call (301) 615-8289.
